parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first().json; let summary=String(x.execution?.error?.message||'workflow failed').replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/g,'[url]'); for(const secret of [$env.LENDLOOP_INBOUND_SECRET,$env.LENDLOOP_OUTBOUND_SECRET]) if(secret) summary=summary.replaceAll(secret,'[redacted]'); summary=summary.replace(/[a-f0-9]{64}/gi,'[digest]').slice(0,160); const record={workflow:String(x.workflow?.name||'unknown').slice(0,80),executionId:String(x.execution?.id||'unknown').slice(0,80),failedAt:new Date().toISOString(),step:String(x.execution?.lastNodeExecuted||'unknown').slice(0,80),summary}; console.error(JSON.stringify(record)); return [{json:record}];
